title: Planet Tweaks V2.7.9 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Ghost App Tree Termination, Shift Chat Bypass & Studio Overhaul
releaseNotes: Ghost Apps Obliteration: Upgraded freeze engine to aggressively stop services and kill entire process trees (taskkill /F /T) with instant Force Close button. Shift Key Macro Bypass: Holding Shift now pauses all macro injection and key suppression for seamless in-game typing. Crosshair Studio Redesign: Added smooth scrolling, fixed loadout preset loading, compact overlay toggle, and cleaner controls. Cyber Slider: Sleek metallic pill thumb and obsidian track styling. GamerTag & Theme Persistence: Fixed GamerTag and active theme sync on startup. Random Tools Tab: Added quick access system tools.
